notes.title: Patchnote 1.7.1
notes.content:
Bug fix:
- The score shown in the leaderboard on the selection map is now correct.
- The total time of a complete time attack run is now correctly saved and populate the dedicated leaderboard.
- The leaderboards shown during the time attack mode now show the player times accuratly.
- The Timo Bros success can now be achieved if you restart the game after adding a community.

notes.title: Update 1.6.4
notes.content:
Features : 

- It's now possible to select a level on the map by clicking on the temples

- The order of the hardcore levels has changed



Bugfixs :

- The leaderboard on the map now show the rank of the player as it should
